WITH config AS (
  SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key,value) AS values
  FROM settings
  WHERE key = ANY (ARRAY[
    'OBSERVABILITY_PERIOD','OBSERVABILITY_VERSION','OBSERVABILITY_STALE_RUN_MINUTES',
    'OBSERVABILITY_HIGH_VIRALITY_THRESHOLD','OBSERVABILITY_HIGH_OPPORTUNITY_THRESHOLD',
    'OBSERVABILITY_ERROR_LIMIT','OBSERVABILITY_TIMEZONE'
  ])
), started AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_runs (workflow,status,metadata)
  SELECT '10 - TrendLens - Observability','running',
         jsonb_build_object(
           'configuration',coalesce(values,'{}'::jsonb),
           'window_policy','closed_hour',
           'quantitative_source','postgresql',
           'sensitive_error_fields_exposed',false
         )
  FROM config
  RETURNING id,started_at,metadata
)
SELECT id AS pipeline_run_id,started_at AS run_started_at,metadata
FROM started;

WITH generated AS (
  SELECT * FROM build_pipeline_observability($2::timestamptz)
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_observability_reports (
    period_start,period_end,generated_at,observability_version,
    overall_status,workflow_count,run_count,error_count,retry_count,
    report_json,source_hash
  )
  SELECT
    period_start,period_end,generated_at,observability_version,
    overall_status,workflow_count,run_count,error_count,retry_count,
    report_json,source_hash
  FROM generated
  ON CONFLICT (period_start,period_end,observability_version,source_hash)
  DO NOTHING
  RETURNING pipeline_observability_reports.*,true AS report_created
), resolved AS (
  SELECT * FROM inserted
  UNION ALL
  SELECT existing.*,false AS report_created
  FROM pipeline_observability_reports existing
  CROSS JOIN generated
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
    AND existing.period_start=generated.period_start
    AND existing.period_end=generated.period_end
    AND existing.observability_version=generated.observability_version
    AND existing.source_hash=generated.source_hash
  LIMIT 1
), updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
  SET items_received=resolved.workflow_count,
      items_processed=CASE WHEN resolved.report_created THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
      items_skipped=CASE WHEN resolved.report_created THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
      metadata=metadata || jsonb_build_object(
        'observability_report_id',resolved.id,
        'report_created',resolved.report_created,
        'overall_status',resolved.overall_status,
        'workflows_observed',resolved.workflow_count,
        'runs_observed',resolved.run_count,
        'error_events',resolved.error_count,
        'retries_recorded',resolved.retry_count,
        'period_start',resolved.period_start,
        'period_end',resolved.period_end,
        'observability_version',resolved.observability_version,
        'source_hash',resolved.source_hash
      )
  FROM resolved
  WHERE pipeline_runs.id=$1::bigint
  RETURNING pipeline_runs.*
)
SELECT
  updated.id AS pipeline_run_id,
  resolved.id AS observability_report_id,
  resolved.report_created,resolved.overall_status,
  resolved.period_start,resolved.period_end,resolved.generated_at,
  resolved.observability_version,resolved.workflow_count,
  resolved.run_count,resolved.error_count,resolved.retry_count,
  resolved.report_json,resolved.source_hash
FROM updated CROSS JOIN resolved;

WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
  SET finished_at=coalesce(finished_at,current_timestamp),
      status='success',
      duration_seconds=coalesce(duration_seconds,extract(epoch FROM (current_timestamp-started_at)))
  WHERE id=$1::bigint
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT
  updated.id AS pipeline_run_id,updated.workflow,updated.status,
  updated.items_received,updated.items_processed,updated.items_skipped,
  updated.items_failed,updated.duration_seconds,updated.metadata,
  updated.started_at,updated.finished_at,
  report.id AS observability_report_id,report.overall_status,
  report.report_json,report.source_hash
FROM updated
LEFT JOIN pipeline_observability_reports report
  ON report.id=(updated.metadata ->> 'observability_report_id')::bigint;

WITH args AS (
  SELECT $1::bigint AS run_id,$2::text AS message
), logged AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_errors (
    pipeline_run_id,workflow,node,error_type,error_message,retry_count,metadata
  )
  SELECT args.run_id,'10 - TrendLens - Observability',
         'Gerar e persistir observabilidade','observability_generation_error',
         left(regexp_replace(args.message,'(?i)(authorization|api[_-]?key|token|password|secret)[^ ,;]*','[REDACTED]','g'),4000),
         2,jsonb_build_object(
           'window_policy','closed_hour',
           'sensitive_error_fields_exposed',false
         )
  FROM args
  RETURNING id
), updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
  SET finished_at=current_timestamp,status='failed',items_failed=items_failed+1,
      duration_seconds=extract(epoch FROM (current_timestamp-started_at))
  FROM args
  WHERE pipeline_runs.id=args.run_id
  RETURNING pipeline_runs.*
)
SELECT updated.id AS pipeline_run_id,updated.status,updated.items_failed,
       (SELECT id FROM logged) AS pipeline_error_id
FROM updated;
